Those enhanced subsidies were always sold to the public as temporary emergency relief during COVID. More importantly, the enhanced subsidies have contributed to a situation where millions of Americans now receive health insurance that costs them $10 or less per year in premium, which has dramatically weakened the incentive for insurers and providers to control costs.
